title: Papyrus Lint script collision cache
description: One `{game}-{sha256-of-lowercase-filename}-collisions.json` file inside an ast-cache directory (see app/crates/papyrus-lint-core/src/collision_cache.rs). Lists every known implementer of a script file name so conflicting-script-versions can compare copies by SHA-256 without reopening a still-fresh `.psc`.

scriptname.description: Lowercased `.psc` file name this document indexes, including the extension (e.g. `example.psc`).

hash.description: Lowercase hex digest of the decoded source text using `algorithm`.

mtime.description: The implementer's last-modified time as a decimal string of whole seconds since the Unix epoch, captured when the hash was written. A cache hit requires this to still match the file's current mtime.

path.description: Absolute path of this copy of the script.
